objective: server/domain/personName.ts: looksLikeAddress requires a single bare address, so personName({displayName:'Rosser Peyton <rosserpeyton@gmail.com>'}) shows the whole string to every member (section 47: a person is not an address), refuseAddressAsName lets it through, and 'mailto:a@b.com' renders as 'mailto:a'. Fix: add containsAddress(value) that splits on whitespace, strips <>, mailto: and trailing punctuation, and tests each token with looksLikeAddress; personName drops address tokens and returns the rest, falling back to the local part; refuseAddressAsName refuses when containsAddress. Keep looksLikeAddress unchanged and keep both exported names (tests/signInIdentity.test.ts checks them). tests/russellFoundationCloseout.test.ts cases ('DJ @ Night' unchanged, '@handle', 'a@b', 'a@@b.com' false) must keep passing.
expectedOutcome: No displayed name carries an email address.

acceptanceConditions.statement: names containing an address are stripped and refused, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
